implementation.legacy_boundary: The immutable national archive retains its original specification. This separately hashed Python design supersedes its unexecuted municipal R implementation.

role: Primary municipal counterfactual impact design; separate from national SVAR dynamics
estimand: ATT(g,t) of the first verified qualifying foreign-invested operational opening; average over event years 1–5
population: Eligible municipalities with verified treatment histories and comparable annual outcomes; not all FDI dollars

dag.unblocked_risk: Unobserved time-varying local prospects or policy packages can violate conditional parallel trends. Observed covariates cannot prove this path absent.

assumptions: Conditional parallel trends in untreated potential outcomes
No effects earlier than the two-year anticipation allowance
Verified first qualifying operational opening and prior-exposure histories
Adequate common support for each treated cohort and comparison set
Comparable outcome definitions and geographic boundaries

audit.overlap_failure_policy: Block the affected comparison; never silently clip propensity scores or trim the estimand
audit.covariate_policy: All baseline covariates constant within municipality and measured at one common year no later than the earliest eligible opening minus three; comparisons share that covariate vintage. Outcome changes use each cohort's clean base year.
audit.comparison_policy: Never treated or not yet treated and outside their anticipation window; absence from a short project list does not establish untreated status
audit.placebo_policy: Report clean pretreatment pseudo-effects and joint test, false timing within clean pretreatment, and neighboring-municipality exclusions when a verified adjacency file exists
audit.pretrend_policy: Passing a pretrend test does not prove parallel trends; failures block a causal-results label and remain visible

robustness: Cohort and sector estimates only where support passes
national_boundary: The completed SVAR and identified-shock local projections remain conditional on their frozen recursive restrictions. The handbook is not presented as independent validation of those restrictions.
